title: Interval Timing Task
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 139 subjects (94 individuals with Parkinson's disease and 45 controls) performing an Interval Timing task. EEG data were collected with a 64-channel BrainVision system while participants judged short (3-second) and long (7-second) time intervals following visual cues. The dataset is intended to support research into timing perception and its neural correlates in Parkinson's disease.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel BrainVision cap while participants performed an interval timing task. Instructional text ('Short interval' or 'Long interval') was displayed for 1 second, followed by a visual cue (a solid box) indicating the start of the interval, lasting 6 s for 3-s trials and 14 s for 7-s trials. Participants pressed a spacebar when they judged the interval had elapsed, without counting, and a distractor vowel appeared at random intervals.
